# `prefer-early-return`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an `if` whose `else` block contains only a return.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Inverting the condition into an early-return guard lets the main path continue
at the surrounding indentation level.

## When it fires

The else block must contain exactly one return statement. No edit is offered
because removing the main-path block can change declaration scope, defer
lifetime, and comment placement.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn parse(s: []const u8) !u32 {
    if (s.len > 0) {
        return s[0];
    } else {
        return error.Empty;
    }
}
```
